title: The Animal That Regrows Its Limbs
hook: A lost limb can grow back, if you are an axolotl.
script: A lost limb can grow back, if you are an axolotl. An axolotl regrows a whole missing leg in 40 to 50 days. Bone, muscle and nerves all return, without scarring. So why can't a person do this? We seal wounds with scars. It rebuilds the missing part instead. It can even repair its spinal cord, and parts of its heart and brain. Has anyone made a human limb regrow yet? Not once. Is it a hard limit for mammals, or a switch nobody has found yet?
